name: s0aptile/fossh-php
description: PHP binding for foSSH (privacy-preserving, embeddable telemetry) via the FFI extension.

suggest.ext-ffi: Required for in-process recording; falls back to an HTTP-remote transport, then spawning the fossh-cgi binary, then a documented no-op, without it.
suggest.ext-curl: Preferred transport for HTTP-remote mode (shared hosting); falls back to a stream-context request without it.
